summary: Blue Owl Credit Income Corp. filed an 8-K reporting that on September 16, 2026 it entered into the Fourth Amendment to its Amended and Restated Senior Secured Revolving Credit Agreement, with Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation as administrative and collateral agent. The amendment extends the revolver availability period from October 2028 to September 2030 and maturity from October 2029 to September 2031, raises the facility from $3.9B to $4.2B, lifts the accordion cap to $6.3B, cuts applicable margins, and resets the minimum shareholders' equity test. This is a routine credit-facility repricing; no equity special situation arises.
